sample_projects.name: E-Commerce Landing Page & API Integration
sample_projects.description: Build a high-converting landing page for a new product launch with integrated checkout. The page must be mobile-responsive, load in under 2 seconds, and connect to a payment authorization endpoint. Deliverables include: 1) Responsive frontend layout (HTML/CSS/JS) matching Figma design, 2) Payment integration connecting checkout buttons to authorization API, 3) Order confirmation page with transaction details. Acceptance criteria: passes automated responsive testing on Chrome/Safari/mobile viewports; order creation and payment authorization execute with HTTP 200/201 and valid JSON payload; page loads in under 2s on 3G.

sample_projects.name: React Native Mobile App - Task Manager
sample_projects.description: Develop a cross-platform task management mobile app using React Native with TypeScript. Features: user authentication (email/password + OAuth), project boards with drag-and-drop tasks, offline-first data sync with local SQLite, push notifications for due dates, dark/light theme. Deliverables: 1) Authenticated app shell with navigation, 2) Project/task CRUD with optimistic UI, 3) Offline sync engine with conflict resolution, 4) Notification service integration. Acceptance criteria: app builds and runs on iOS Simulator and Android Emulator; all CRUD operations work offline and sync when online; push notifications received on both platforms; TypeScript strict mode passes with zero errors.

sample_projects.name: Python FastAPI Backend - Analytics Dashboard API
sample_projects.description: Create a production-ready analytics API for a SaaS dashboard. Stack: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery. Endpoints: authentication (JWT), event ingestion (high-throughput), aggregation queries (time-series), export (CSV/PDF). Deliverables: 1) Auth module with roles and rate limiting, 2) Event ingestion pipeline handling 10k req/s with batching, 3) Aggregation service with pre-computed rollups, 4) Export jobs with async Celery workers, 5) OpenAPI docs and integration tests. Acceptance criteria: all endpoints return correct schemas per OpenAPI; ingestion handles 10k events/sec with <100ms p99 latency; aggregation queries return in <500ms; export jobs complete within 30s for 100k rows; test coverage >85%; Docker Compose spins up full stack.
